stem: ![](asset:P000281-stem-1)  A swimmer wants to cross a river from point A to point B. Line AB makes an angle of $30{^\circ}$ with the flow of river. The magnitude of the velocity of the swimmer is same as that of the river. The angle θ with the line AB should be ….. $.{^\circ}$, so that the swimmer reaches point B?

assets.alt: A river with the current flowing to the right, shown by arrows. A boat leaves A heading at angle θ to the line AB, which makes 30° with the bank; B is on the far bank.
A swimmer's velocity v plus the river's v (equal lengths) give a resultant from A towards B at 30° to the flow. Note: equal sides make the base angles equal, θ = 30°.
